incident-bot: PAGER: Multiple OOMs observed in decode-prod-eu-1 GPU pool during streaming decode. Frequent CUDA mem alloc failures and container restarts. Severity P2 — paging oncall.

mia (oncall): Ack. Joining. Starting oncall runbook and gathering logs.

leo: Seeing repeated stack traces: `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` during streaming decode for model rwd-7b-quant. Example log: ```[WARN] decode(node-12): cudaMalloc failed: out of memory; requested 12345678 bytes; backtrace...```

irene: Telemetry shows a sharp uptick in long-lived KV cache entries tied to requests with chained function/tool calls. Some requests have X-Redwood-Max-Tokens header set to 0 (SDK bug) which effectively disables truncation — leads to token inflation.

mia (oncall): Can we enforce a hard ingress cap while we triage? I can push a header rewrite to set X-Redwood-Max-Tokens=2048 for this route.

leo: Drafting nginx map + rewrite for the ingress: ```map $http_x_redwood_max_tokens $cap { default $http_x_redwood_max_tokens; '' 2048; } proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Max-Tokens $cap;``` Will canary to one node.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: ingress-nginx header rewrite rollout -> decode-prod-eu-1 canary (1 node).

irene: Customer impact summary: ~0.8% of streaming requests returned drops/early terminations in the last 30m. Bulk are long conversational traces with many tool calls. CS ticket CS-9872 opened for outreach.

mia (oncall): Short mitigations: 1) canary ingress header cap, 2) enforce server-side request-duration cap = 45s, 3) enable soft-eviction for KV cache > 5MB.

leo: Applying soft-eviction: ```rwdctl runtime set --pool decode-prod-eu-1 --kv-evict-threshold 5MB --kv-evict-mode soft``` Pushing now to canary node.

ops-bot: KV soft-evict applied to canary. Monitoring GPU memory and decode failures. If OOMs persist next step is +2 GPUs and route 30% traffic to fallback model variant.

mia (oncall): @leo @irene after the header patch please run a small traffic replay (staging trace) to validate. Need confirmation that request drops stop before wider rollout.

leo: Starting replay with 5k requests from staging trace now.

leo: Replay finished — OOMs reduced by ~92%. Remaining spikes traced to a single customer workload that chains ~20 tools in one session.

irene: OK — we should proactively contact that customer with mitigation suggestions and an SDK patch. I'll draft the customer note; CS to send and offer temporary throttling guidance.

mia (oncall): :thumbsup: Keeping P2. I will stay on until +2h and then hand to daytime oncall. Adding follow-ups: SDK patch PR #642, ops runbook updates for ingress caps and KV eviction.

incident-bot: Incident updated: mitigation applied, partial customer impact, assigned owners: mia (oncall), leo, irene. Follow-ups: SDK patch, runbook edits, customer outreach.

ops-bot: Postmortem stub created: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-1765558888 (please fill in timeline + RCA).

mia (oncall): Handoff note: will pass active pager to @sam in +2h with logs, replay results, and CS contact details. Leaving live channel open for any regressions.
